userGuidance.scope: Enumerate and audit EVERY checked-in file (1110 files). Anti-AI-slop every file. Three factors: correctness, conformance, quality. Fix all bugs. Clean up all mess. Nine hours. Blast subagents. Commit regularly after strict-review-gate. ALL checks must pass: gmake make-all-with-log AND Linux AND Windows targets. Reread blueprint regularly.

globalAlerts.warning: BUILD FIRST: gmake build before running scripts.
TEST AFTER EVERY CHANGE: go test -short -count=1 -timeout=10m ./...
ZERO TOLERANCE: Tests isolated, no host state mutation, no flaky tests.
PLATFORM COMPAT: All code works on Linux, macOS, Windows. Cross-platform targets must pass.
RULE OF TWO: Two contiguous issue-free subagent reviews before every commit.
NO GIT CLI: Use gitops Go package. Only PullRebase may shell out.
JS BINDING CONTRACT: All I/O returns Promises. No context.Background() in bindings.
NO SHIMS: One implementation. Update all call sites. Delete boldly.
DEADCODE: Never add to .deadcodeignore. Wire up or delete dead code.
NAMING: No prepositions (From, Into, To, By, On, In, Of, For) in public APIs.
STRUCTURED LOGGING: lowercase, event-phrased, camelCase attrs via slog.
THREE FACTORS: Every file checked for (1) correctness (2) conformance (3) quality. No AI slop.
ALL CHECKS ALL PLATFORMS: gmake make-all-with-log + Linux container + Windows remote must ALL pass.
REREAD BLUEPRINT: Reread blueprint.json regularly for user guidance and task state.

sequentialTasks.task: Address scratch/review-01..03.md findings on the audit diff
sequentialTasks.description: Adjudicate conflicting review claims by reading source first-hand. Fix confirmed bugs: (1) pr_split_06_verification.js startVerifySession .catch() on possibly-sync gitExec — guard with typeof .then; (2) go.mod stale dop251 direct reqs — go mod tidy (removed entirely; goja-grpc uses joeycumines/goja); (3) prsplittest/eval.go __evalResult_N/__evalError_N globals leak — delete after settle; (4) pty_windows.go STARTF_USESTDHANDLES with zeroed handles — remove flag (MS ConPTY sample relies on PSEUDOCONSOLE attr); (5) pr_split_16b startAnalysis async path returns Promise → bubbletea.updateDirect rejects non-Array — return [s,cmd], launch config validation in background, stash s._cfgPromise; (6) pr_split_16d startAutoAnalysis same + autoConfigValidating flag + handleAutoSplitPoll routing. Confirmed NOT bugs (no change): bridge.Stop() mutex order (would deadlock), capture.go double Wait() (proc.Wait reads <-p.done channel), agent-fix detect sync (isAvailable is async/blocking; explicit test forbids sync call; resolved is reliable proxy), break-pane activation (intentional, matches tmux), lookupBinaryAsync awaits fileExistsSync (00_core fileExistsSync IS async).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: All review-identified issues fixed or adjudicated with first-hand evidence. Rule of Two: two contiguous subagent PASS reviews (scratch/run1-review.md, scratch/run2-review.md). go build + GOOS=windows build + go vet + gmake lint + go test -short ./... + go test -short -race ./internal/command/... all PASS.

sequentialTasks.task: Scope expansion: surface config-promise rejection errors in TUI poll handlers
sequentialTasks.description: Both Rule-of-Two reviewers independently flagged (LOW, practically unreachable): handleConfigError (pr_split_16b) and handleAutoConfigError (pr_split_16d) set error fields + isProcessing=false, but the poll handlers' early !isProcessing exit silently dropped the error. Fixed by mirroring processConfigResult's error path (set s.configValidationError + s.wizardState='CONFIG'). The rejection path is unreachable in production (exec.execv always resolves, never rejects), so a dedicated unit test is infeasible without invasive module-load restructuring (violates no-shims); verified by structural equivalence to the tested {error:...} resolved path.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: handleConfigError/handleAutoConfigError set configValidationError + wizardState='CONFIG' (rendered by CONFIG view). Structural mirror of processConfigResult's tested error path. Rule of Two v2 PASS.

sequentialTasks.task: Scope expansion: fix flaky -race tests (PTY macOS E-state + bubblezone Gosched starvation)
sequentialTasks.description: Full -race suite had two flaky tests under parallel load. (1) TestProcess_Close_CustomGracePeriod_QuickExit (termmux/pty): macOS session-leader children stuck in 'Exiting' (E) state when parent holds slave tty open — wait4 blocked indefinitely, Close burned full grace+force. Root cause found via ps (?Es state) + slave-close-before-wait probe (120/120 pass). Fixed: Close() now closes slave tty BEFORE the grace/force kill loop (child keeps its own dup'd slave fds, so no EIO/SIGKILL impact). (2) bubblezone waitForZone + TestIntegration_RescanUpdatesZones: runtime.Gosched() 1000-iter busy-wait starved under full-suite -race load. Fixed: 5s deadline + 1ms sleep poll (yields OS thread to worker).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: TestProcess_Close_CustomGracePeriod_QuickExit passes 20x -race. Full pty package 3x -race. bubblezone 3x -race. Full -race suite (go test -short -race -count=1 ./...) PASS with zero failures. Rule of Two v2 PASS.
